basis: Andrew, 5 Nov 2026 (14:2x AEST): "Wc60 toilets and tanks leave at 220pm". WC60 holds two Coates 6 m toilet blocks (1119489, 1087500; ticked Ready 27 Oct; Brenden Meek's bookings for 5 Nov 12:00 on the record) and their two waste tanks (1328980, 1328981); read 14:25 AEST, none already left, so WC60 left in full at 14:20 AEST on Thu 5 Nov 2026.
